title: IntegralModelsSheafTensor
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ a finite subextension of the fixed algebraic closure, and $X$ a Noetherian scheme. Put $A=\mathcal O_E$ and let $A_X$ be its pulled-back condensed coefficient ring [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. For two $A_X$-module sheaves $F,G$ with finite constant scalar constructible models [sk-def-sfb-constructible], their degree-zero derived objects satisfy $F[0]\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{A_X}G[0]\in D^b_c(X,A)$ [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible, sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom]. The tensor is the ambient uncompleted relative tensor.

proof.text: Use the coefficient isomorphism of the integral constant-model heart closure module to compare the finite-subextension coefficient ring with the universe-lifted integral condensed ring. Transport modules along this ring isomorphism. The integral local-finite-presentation/constant-model comparison identifies constant-model constructibility with stratified local finite presentation, in both directions.

source.place: parent steps 4--7: coefficient and model comparison

proof.text: Take the common finite refinement of the two witnessing stratifications using common_lfp_stratification from the condensed constructible Serre module. Transport local finite presentation from raw inverse-image coefficients to Cartesian coefficient pullback. Exact monoidal inverse image identifies the pullback of the tensor of the two degree-zero sheaves with the tensor of their two degree-zero pullbacks. On each stratum apply lfp_tensor_single: the tensor has no cohomology below -1 and its cohomology is locally finitely presented. In Lean first perform this argument for an arbitrary ell-adic finiteness coefficient on a Noetherian scheme in a private helper, then specialize. Use the explicit leftDerivedUpperStarTensorIso and exact functor comparison rather than synthesizing the monoidal tensorator.

source.place: parent steps 4--7: existing local tensor calculation

proof.text: Commute homology with exact inverse image. The finite family of stratum immersions is jointly surjective. Apply abDetectMaps from the abelian closed-support module to the identity of a module whose stratum pullbacks vanish; it is zero, so the module is zero. Apply this to tensor homology below -1. General right t-exactness of derived tensor gives vanishing above 0. The common stratification and the locally finitely presented homology on its strata give constructibility in every degree. Transport this through the coefficient/model equivalence to conclude bounded constant-model constructibility, with bounds [-1,0].

theorem integralModels_sheaf_tensor (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ) (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    (F G : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) X))
    (hF : IsConstantModelConstructible (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) X F)
    (hG : IsConstantModelConstructible (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) X G) :
    constantModelBoundedConstructible (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) X
      (((derivedTensor (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) X).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F)).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj G))
